findings.title: requireUser() always throws in refresh()
findings.why: This change removes the `warmUp()` call from `init`, and nothing else calls `warmUp()`. `cachedUser` therefore stays null, and `requireUser()` always throws IllegalStateException when `refresh()` runs.

signals.reason: displayName() is called on every start, before any name is stored.

questions.text: Is `prefetch()` meant to replace `warmUp()`? Nothing calls it yet.
